events.title: 알바니아 블로러에서 태어나다
events.description_en: She was born in Vlorë, a port city in southern Albania.

events.title: 장학생으로 캐나다 유나이티드월드칼리지에 가다
events.title_en: She went to United World College in Canada on scholarship
events.description: 열여섯에 장학금을 받아 캐나다 밴쿠버섬의 유나이티드월드칼리지로 유학해 국제학력고사 과정을 마쳤다.
events.description_en: At sixteen she won a scholarship to Pearson College UWC on Vancouver Island in Canada and completed the International Baccalaureate there.

events.title: 콜비 칼리지를 졸업하다
events.description: 미국 콜비 칼리지에서 학사 학위를 받았다.
events.description_en: She earned her bachelor's degree from Colby College in the United States.

events.title: 다트머스에서 기계공학을 마치다
events.title_en: She finished mechanical engineering at Dartmouth
events.description: 다트머스 대학 세이어 공과대학에서 기계공학 학사 과정을 마쳤다.
events.description_en: She completed a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering at Dartmouth's Thayer School of Engineering.

events.title: 테슬라에서 제품 개발을 맡다
events.title_en: She worked on product development at Tesla
events.description: 테슬라에서 몇 해 동안 제품 개발 업무를 맡았다.
events.description_en: She spent several years at Tesla working on product development.

events.title: 오픈AI에 합류하다
events.description_en: She joined OpenAI as vice president of Applied AI and Partnerships.

events.title: 오픈AI 최고기술책임자가 되다
events.title_en: She became OpenAI's chief technology officer
events.description: 오픈AI 최고기술책임자로 승진해 챗GPT, 달리, 소라 등 주요 제품 개발을 총괄했다.
events.description_en: She was promoted to chief technology officer of OpenAI and oversaw the development of major products including ChatGPT, DALL-E, and Sora.

events.title: 챗GPT를 세상에 내놓다
events.title_en: ChatGPT was released under her direction
events.description: 그가 이끈 팀이 챗GPT를 공개했다. 몇 달 만에 사용자 수억 명이 몰리며 생성형 AI 대중화를 이끌었다.
events.description_en: The team she led released ChatGPT. Within months it drew hundreds of millions of users and drove generative AI into the mainstream.

events.title: 이사회 해임 사태 중 임시 최고경영자를 맡다
events.title_en: She served as interim CEO during the boardroom crisis
events.description: 이사회가 샘 올트먼을 해임한 직후 며칠간 오픈AI의 임시 최고경영자를 맡았다.
events.description_en: For a few days after the board ousted Sam Altman, she served as OpenAI's interim chief executive.

events.title: 오픈AI를 떠나겠다고 밝히다
events.title_en: She announced her departure from OpenAI
events.description: 육 년 넘게 몸담은 오픈AI를 떠나겠다고 밝혔다. 같은 날 다른 임원들도 잇달아 퇴사를 알렸다.
events.description_en: She announced she was leaving OpenAI after more than six years there. Other top executives announced their own departures the same day.

events.title: 싱킹 머신스 랩을 창업하다
events.description: 오픈AI를 떠난 지 다섯 달 만에 새 AI 회사 싱킹 머신스 랩을 세웠다.
events.description_en: Five months after leaving OpenAI, she founded a new AI company, Thinking Machines Lab.

events.title: 기업가치 백이십억 달러로 대규모 투자를 유치하다
events.title_en: She raised funding at a $12 billion valuation
events.description: 싱킹 머신스 랩이 기업가치 백이십억 달러를 인정받아 이십억 달러를 투자받았다.
events.description_en: Thinking Machines Lab raised two billion dollars at a valuation of twelve billion dollars.
